name: P517 F6 fencing mutation probe (copy-out, r3): submodule non-fast-forward retry must reauthorize (run-git-sync.ts)
command: --test 'D=$(dirname {}); if [ -L "$D/run-git-sync.test.ts" ]; then cp --remove-destination <repo>/packages/operator-core/lib/harness/git-sync/run-git-sync.test.ts "$D/run-git-sync.test.ts" || exit 3; echo MATERIALIZED_TEST_COPY; fi; cd "${D%/lib/harness/git-sync}" && pwd && npx vitest run lib/harness/git-sync/run-git-sync.test.ts -t "F6: submodule non-fast-forward retry reauthorizes" --reporter=dot'
summary: Copy-out (default tier) mutation probe. The tracked tree was never mutated, so no file lock or git-sync lease was needed; the mutant lived only in the probe's repo mirror. The --test materializes a real copy of run-git-sync.test.ts beside the mirrored mutant, but only when the mirrored test is a symlink, so the real-tree baseline runs unchanged. The copy stops Vite from realpathing the symlinked test back into the real tree and importing the real module. Mutated control: 'F6: submodule non-fast-forward retry reauthorizes before another push'. The real-tree baseline passed (1 passed, 160 skipped) and so did the unmutated-mirror baseline. The mutant swallows a beforePush (publication authority) refusal instead of refusing the push, so the retry push proceeded after the owner key became unavailable. The test failed on the push count: expected 2 to be 1. The probe reported MUTANT CAUGHT and verified run-git-sync.ts byte-identical afterwards. The unmutated mirror copy passed and the mutant failed, so the mutated module was the one loaded. This regenerates binding 16317, which went stale when run-git-sync.ts changed. r1 (blob af38742a) and r2 (blob 31086bb9, docs/evidence/p517-run-git-sync-f6-retry-reauth-mutation-copyout-r2-2026-09-30-c8f54.json) were both superseded before binding by peer commits 12135961 and 09109833 (EI-24712906810240170, post-stage guard). At 21:47Z su-4f968faa confirmed those edits final. r3 measured subject blob 168d89c9, which was committed and clean before and after the run. The test blob 5273c3c6 was an uncommitted working-tree edit at run time. That edit is confined to the submodule race test (about l.3317) and does not touch the F6 control at l.3049. The binder checks HEAD:run-git-sync.test.ts == 5273c3c6 after git-sync commits it and before binding.
